zoe (marketing): Heads-up: aiming for Tue 08:00 PT public announce. Need final changelog, docs link, and a one-line bench for the blog. Any API breaks?
ash (eng): No breaking changes. New quantized rwd-4 variant + `perf_mode` flag. Changelog draft coming.
mai (docs): I can push a release page once I have changelog + sample curl. EOD is fine.
zoe (marketing): Also planning Wed 11am PT webinar (30m). Leo will demo perf. Need two slides: p50/p95 and cost delta.
leo (product): Bench highlight request: 128-token gen numbers and cost delta.
ash (eng): Quick bench: rwd-4-small-quant, 128 tokens -> p50=43ms, p95=118ms, ~28% token-cost reduction vs rwd-4-small. Will post config.
tara (growth): For inbound, route blog leads to sales@redwood, add Drift tag "quant-bench", and collect company + volume fields.
mai (docs): Placeholder docs URL: https://docs.redwood-inference.com/releases/rwd4-quant (will update). Adding Upgrade Notes: opt-in model name change only.
nash (eng): Changelog bullets:
- Add rwd-4-small-quant (4-bit) with ~28% cost reduction
- KV-cache optimizations reduce repeat-prefix latency
- New `perf_mode` flag for batching control
Sample curl:
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" -d '{"model":"rwd-4-small-quant","input":"Write a short poem","max_tokens":128}'
zoe (marketing): Sophie, link the curl + changelog in the blog. I'll draft copy Mon 09:00 PT for review.
